'''2009 Worlds Day 2 Matthew Sokol LS Echo Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matthew Sokol]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Echo Base Operations / Hoth: Echo Base Defense]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
